title: Brett Blake: Go Hard or Go Home
original_title: Brett Blake: Go Hard or Go Home
overview: Brett Blake is the king of going hard. This high-energy, mulleted stand-up comedian has had a wild year. From being savagely heckled, to getting into a fight with a bartender, seeing a fat rich snowboarder nearly lose his life, getting stitched up in a drug deal with his uncle, working with the dumbest apprentice in the world and experimenting with the wildest thing at a sex shop!
